english.notes: From 1st November 2019, the Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) (Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2019 (SI 2019/1047) removed the current securities regime, which was used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. A two-year transitional period applied to existing securities and deposits; this meant that new securities could not be issued, however, it did not prevent individuals renewing current securities - as long as they were valid until 1st November 2021. From 1st November 2021 compulsory motor insurance is required. For the offence wording for offences committed on or after that date see H100121.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
